interface.shortDescription: Reusable dotfiles, document, and travel workflows for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Reusable workflows for managed dotfiles deployment, complete arXiv source-version diff PDFs, selecting and packing saved research results for transfer, validating receipts and integrating them with existing inputs, drafting remote-agent instructions for these operations, writing or reviewing Typst research reports, proofreading existing English scientific manuscripts while preserving scientific meaning and explaining important changes in Japanese, creating, editing, or reviewing scientific Typst figures without modifying artifacts in review mode, portable editable figure bundles, and calendar files from travel reservation Markdown.
defaultPrompt: Create an arXiv version diff PDF
Create, edit, or review a scientific Typst figure
Write or review a Typst research report
Proofread an English paper and explain changes in Japanese
Create calendar files from travel reservations
Package or receive and integrate saved research results
